calibration.status_reason: Evaluated on complete overlapping months with a chronological holdout.

limitations: These are active-fire detections and cell-days, not confirmed fire events or burned area.
VIIRS is a comparison reference, not ground truth.
The evaluated artifact uses a chronological holdout; this is cross-sensor agreement, not independent accuracy validation.
Coverage completeness is not established by positive detections alone.
No individual hotspot coordinates are included; the map must not invent markers.
Cloud and orbital completeness fields are unavailable in the Area API aggregates.
